criteria_text.exploitation: Being attacked? (KEV = attacked in the wild; EPSS = chance of attack in 30 days; hard supply-chain signals)
criteria_text.impact: How bad if exploited (advisory severity / CVSS)
criteria_text.exposure: Where it runs (shipped runtime code vs dev-only tooling)
criteria_text.introduced: Added by this PR (vs already present before)

lockfile_tamper.why: Package resolved from a host that is not on the allow-list / integrity changed

untrusted_source.why: Package downloaded from a server that is not on the registry allow-list

new_install_script.why: New package runs code at install time

typosquat.why: Name is a near-copy of a popular package

method.verdict_rule: block if the change introduces a critical finding or an SSVC 'Act' decision; review if it introduces a finding of high or critical severity (CVE, supply-chain or CI), even when exploitation data lowered its priority level; otherwise allow
